_clip_model: B32 (default, ~600MB, fast) | L14 (~1.7GB, better separation) | SO400M (SigLIP at 384px, ~3.5GB, strongest on text and slowest). Scores from two models are NOT comparable -- different vector spaces. Switching re-embeds the folder once, then caches per model, so switching back is instant.
_objective: PICK ONE: reference_dir OR caption. Setting both is a config error -- with two objectives a result cannot be attributed to either. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader (JSON has no comments).
_caption_example: To switch to caption scoring: set reference_dir to "" and move the two keys below out of _disabled_caption_example, or just pass --caption on the command line, which does both for you.
